name: Scroll-Driven Character Opacity Wave & Fluid Editorial Stagger
description: Directs editorial reading focus by progressively illuminating text character-by-character as the user scrolls. Characters transition from ambient opacity 0.2 to full opacity 1.0 based on viewport progress, eliminating layout shift with ghost spans.
designPhilosophy: Directing editorial focus through progressive typographic illumination. Instead of confronting the reader with a static block of text, words start in an ambient, subdued state (opacity 0.2) and illuminate character-by-character to full opacity (1.0) as the user scrolls through the reading zone, creating a captivating sense of active reading cadence.
appropriateUseCases: Manifesto statements, personal about intros, and philosophical mission copy
High-end editorial storytelling and design agency vision statements
Legal, ethical, or architectural value propositions requiring deliberate visitor attention
implementationApproach: 1. Split Character Parsing: Tokenize paragraph into words and individual character spans. 2. Ghost Baseline Layout: Pair each character with an invisible layout placeholder (opacity: 0) and an absolutely positioned animated character span to prevent inline wrap shifting. 3. Scroll Progress Mapping: Track container scroll progress using Framer Motion useScroll with target element offset ['start 0.8', 'end 0.2']. 4. Normalized Character Threshold: Compute start and end progress range for character index i: start = i / totalChars, end = (i + 1) / totalChars. 5. Opacity Interpolation: Map progress from [start, end] to opacity [0.2, 1.0], using will-change: opacity.
performanceConsiderations: Only animates opacity, never altering geometry or line-height. Renders lightweight spans without re-parsing text on subsequent scrolls.
accessibilityRequirements: Parent container retains full plain text in aria-label to ensure screen readers read the sentence continuously without stuttering across individual character spans. Honors prefers-reduced-motion by rendering all characters at opacity 1.0 immediately.
